description: Ministry of Labour, Trade Union Relation and Sabaragamuwa Development - Appoint the persons to be member the wages board for the retail & wholesale Trade for a period of three years commencing from 01.12.2017
categorisation: This gazette exclusively lists the appointment of named individuals (Mr. Mil Roy Mendis, Mr. I. W. Chandrasiri, etc.) to the Wages Board for the Retail & Wholesale Trade. It names the appointing authority (the Hon. Minister of Labour) but does not describe or change that minister's detailed portfolio responsibilities. The content focuses solely on personnel appointments with basic titles (e.g., "Nominated Members," "Employers’ Representatives"), fitting the definition of a People Gazette (Type 2).
